about.body: Describe what you need, or schedule a consultation. The first conversation is about your project and what it needs, not about us.
about.title: Tell us what

caseStudy.body: Same process, same standards. Start with what you are building; the scope decides the rest.
caseStudy.title: Want a build
caseStudy.titleAccent: you can inspect like this one?

faq.body: Describe the project and add your question. You get a direct answer, not a sales script.
faq.title: Your question is not here?

maintenance.body: Send the site you run today. We check its stack and current state first, then recommend the plan that fits it, not the largest one.
maintenance.title: Already live?

standards.body: The technical audit measures an existing site against the same four benchmarks and returns a written list of what fails and why, before any rebuild is on the table.
standards.title: Hold your current site

work.body: Describe what you need. We reply with whether it fits what we build, and what the next step is.
work.nextStatus: Starts with a short description of what you need.
work.title: Want yours built

writing.body: When an article describes a problem you already have, the estimator turns it into a price range in a few minutes, with no call and no contact details.
writing.title: Reading is research.
writing.titleAccent: An estimate is the next step.
